newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi cuts March crude price to Asia by 10-20 cts.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts March crude price to Asia by 10-20 cts.

text.p: TOKYO, Feb 4 - Saudi Arabia has said it will cut its March-lifting crude oil price formula to Asian customers by 10 to 20 cents a barrel, traders here said on Tuesday.
The March term contract price for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 60 cents, compared with plus 75 cents for February, traders said.
The March crude price formula for Arab Medium was set at the Oman/Dubai average minus 40 cents, compared with minus 30 cents in February.
Arab Heavy was set at the Oman/Dubai average minus $1.25 for March, compared with minus $1.15 for February.
Arab Extra Light for March was priced at the Oman/Dubai average plus $1.95, compared with $2.15 for February.
